# package client

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec102/client"
```

Package client is the controlling station of IEC 60870-5-102: the primary station of unbalanced transmission that reads integrated totals, single-point information, the product specification and the system time of one integrated total station (a meter or a data concentrator).

IEC 60870-5-102 is request driven: the client polls only while a request is open. A request is sent with send/confirm (function 3); the client then polls for user data, class 1 while the station sets ACD and class 2 otherwise, until the answer is complete:

  - UntilReply: the first ASDU of the station that is not the mirror of the request (C\_RD\_NA\_2 is answered by P\_MP\_NA\_2, C\_TI\_NA\_2 by M\_TI\_TA\_2);
  - UntilConfirmation: the activation confirmation, the request mirrored with cause 7;
  - UntilTermination: the activation termination, the request mirrored with cause 10, after the confirmation and the data (cause 5).

A mirror with the P/N bit or a cause 13..18 ends any request with an [\*iec102.RefusedError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec102#RefusedError). These procedures are those of the recorded traffic (innoWatt log: C\_AC\_NA\_2 confirmed with cause 7; C\_CI\_NU\_2 confirmed, 744 ASDUs M\_IT\_TK\_2 with cause 5, terminated with cause 10) and of gisce/iec870ree; the Beckhoff TS650x manual describes no application procedure. They are interpretations; see docs/iec102/INTEROPERABILITY.md.

The link is initialized (request status of link, reset of remote link) by [Client.Init](#func-client-init) or the first request, and again after the station stopped answering. Requests run one at a time; a second waits.

#### func (Client) Close

```go
func (c *Client) Close() error
```

Close stops the station. Outstanding requests fail with [iec102.ErrClosed](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec102#ErrClosed).

#### func (Client) CommonAddr

```go
func (c *Client) CommonAddr() uint16
```

CommonAddr returns the common address of ASDU the requests carry.

#### func (Client) Init

```go
func (c *Client) Init(ctx context.Context) error
```

Init initializes the link: request status of link, then reset of remote link (IEC 60870-5-2 as profiled by IEC 60870-5-101:2003, clause 6.2; gisce/iec870ree and daiiniel/IEC60870-5-102 do the same).

#### func (Client) ReadProductSpec

```go
func (c *Client) ReadProductSpec(ctx context.Context) (iec102.ProductSpec, error)
```

ReadProductSpec reads the manufacturer and product specification: C\_RD\_NA\_2 with cause 5, answered by P\_MP\_NA\_2 (gisce/iec870ree).

#### func (Client) ReadSinglePoints

```go
func (c *Client) ReadSinglePoints(ctx context.Context, record uint8, from, to *iec102.TimeA) ([]iec102.SinglePoint, error)
```

ReadSinglePoints reads the single-point information of record address record (a list address 50..55, Beckhoff TS650x manual, section 9.1.8): all of it with C\_SP\_NA\_2, or the time range from..to with C\_SP\_NB\_2 when both are given; cause 6.

#### func (Client) ReadTime

```go
func (c *Client) ReadTime(ctx context.Context) (iec102.TimeB, error)
```

ReadTime reads the current system time of the station: C\_TI\_NA\_2 with cause 5, answered by M\_TI\_TA\_2 (gisce/iec870ree).

#### func (Client) ReadTotals

```go
func (c *Client) ReadTotals(ctx context.Context, record uint8, q iec102.Read) ([]iec102.IntegratedTotals, error)
```

ReadTotals reads integrated totals with one of the read commands C\_CI\_NA\_2 .. C\_CI\_NU\_2 (q.T; the fields q carries depend on it, see iec102.Read) from record address record, with cause 6, and returns the integration periods the station sent, in order.

#### func (Client) Request

```go
func (c *Client) Request(ctx context.Context, a *iec102.ASDU, until Until) ([]*iec102.ASDU, error)
```

Request sends a and collects the station's answers until the request is complete by rule until. It returns every ASDU of the station's common address received meanwhile, the mirrors included. A refusal returns the answers so far and an [\*iec102.RefusedError](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec60870-5/iec102#RefusedError).

### type Config

```go
type Config struct {
	// Link holds the link timing (Timeout, Retries) and hooks; Link.FT12
	// is set from LinkAddrSize.
	Link link.Config
	// LinkAddrSize is the size of the link address field: 1 or 2 octets,
	// [iec102.NoLinkAddr] for none. Zero means
	// [iec102.DefaultLinkAddrSize].
	LinkAddrSize int
	// LinkAddr is the link address of the integrated total station.
	LinkAddr uint16
	// CommonAddr is the common address of ASDU (the REE profile's
	// measuring point address) the requests carry.
	CommonAddr uint16
	// Params are the codec parameters: common address size, time zone and
	// profile (for example ree.Profile).
	Params iec102.Params

	// PollInterval is the pause between polls the station answers without
	// data while a request is open. Zero means [DefaultPollInterval].
	PollInterval time.Duration
	// RequestTimeout bounds every request whose context has no deadline.
	// Zero means [DefaultRequestTimeout]; long load profiles need more.
	RequestTimeout time.Duration

	// Handler receives the ASDUs that answer no request: those of another
	// common address. It runs on a goroutine of its own, in order.
	Handler func(a *iec102.ASDU)
	// OnState is called with each change of the link state.
	OnState func(s iec102.State, err error)
	// Logger receives the log entries; nil is silent.
	Logger iec60870.Logger
}
```

Config configures a client.
